# Agenda edits restore selection only for the item that was selected

Entry 1283 records the removed agenda row ID only when that row is selected, then restores selection when the matching item is inserted. It clears the transient ID at the batch boundaries and when clearing calendar items. At the accepted revision, removeListItem removes the DOM row, while the tree mixin stores selectedRow separately; this explains why the identity check can follow removal. For this agenda edit path, preserve item identity rather than letting an unrelated modification steal selection. This is a scoped source pattern; no selection, focus or live calendar test was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Calendar agenda selection restoration.
